// File Organization Utility
SORTSHELF
FILE ORGANIZATION UTILITY · WINDOWS · v0.3
Live

Your Downloads folder is chaos. SortShelf scans a target folder, categorizes every file by type, previews the moves before anything happens, then sorts with one click. Safe by default — dry run mode is always on. One-step undo if you change your mind.

Features
  • Sorts into 10 categories automatically
  • Preview every move before execution
  • Safe by default — nothing moves without approval
  • One-step undo
  • Watches folders for new files automatically
  • Protected path block — never touches your project directories
